integrity: The full bracket-preservation conditions are derived from the original bilinear multiplication, the three components are parametrized over every field, and exact enumerative formulas are proved by finite-dimensional linear algebra and inclusion-exclusion. Finite-field checks are independent consistency evidence, not proof of a field-uniform theorem.
scientific_limitations: The geometric statement concerns the reduced endomorphism variety, not the unreduced homomorphism scheme.
Finite-field counts enumerate labeled endomorphisms, not isomorphism or conjugacy classes.
An uncatalogued computation under alternate Leibniz-algebra indexing remains an originality risk.
title: Three affine components in a nilpotent Leibniz endomorphism variety
